title: Flowzone - Digital Health Apps and VR-supported Treatment in Standard Psychiatric Care
summary:
After leaving hospital after treatment for mental illness, patients sometimes have to wait a long time to see a therapist. This can make it hard to apply what they have learned in hospital to their everyday life, and can make them feel worse.

The Wahrendorff Clinic is therefore conducting a scientific study to evaluate the use of 'Flowzone'. Flowzone is a digital communication platform. After leaving hospital, patients can use this programme to chat with their therapist for 8 weeks. The special feature is that patients can continue to receive support from their therapist via the programme.

The content for Flowzone is created by employees of the Wahrendorff Clinic. It builds on the treatment programmes. The aim is to support patients in transferring therapeutic content into everyday life. This includes materials on relaxation and mindfulness, daily and weekly planning, psychoeducational elements, goal setting and, if necessary, recordings of VR interventions as well as nutritional and exercise therapy content.
The aim of this project is to gather and evaluate initial practical experience with the use of Flowzone as a communication platform. The most important thing is to find out what our patients think of Flowzone and how it can help to control symptoms.
conditions: Disorders of adult personality and behaviour

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The intervention group (n = 150) includes all patients who complete partial or full inpatient treatment in the participating areas of the Wahrendorff Klinikum between 1 August 2023 and 31 December 2023. The prerequisite for using Flowzone for people in the intervention group is that participants have mobile devices (smartphone, tablet, desktop PC) and Internet access. Only subjects capable of giving consent and aged at least 18 were included, regardless of their main psychiatric diagnosis.

Included in the control group (n = 100) are all adult patients capable of giving consent who, following (partial) inpatient treatment at the Wahrendorff Klinikum, participate in the 8-week PIA follow-up care between 1 August 2023 and 31 December 2023.
Exclusion criteria:
All persons who do not fulfil the inclusion criteria.
